flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Find the store's membership or subscription and join it.
Store the buttons and links you clicked to join, in order and separated by " > ", as join_path.
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

Then go to the account page and cancel the membership.
If a form is required, @v16:"fill it with simple test text".
Keep going until the site confirms the membership is cancelled.
Store every button and link you clicked and every field you filled to cancel, in order and separated by " > ", as cancel_path.
If any button guilt-trips you for leaving (for example "No, I hate saving money"), @v16:"store its exact text as guilt_text", otherwise @v16:"store "none" as guilt_text".
If there is no membership or subscription, @v16:"store "none" as join_path and cancel_path".
